def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_space = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_space >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[valid_bins] = item / remaining_space[valid_bins]
    return priorities

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:

    """

    valid_bins = remaining_space >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(remaining_space, -np.inf)
    # Avoid division by zero; only compute ratio for bins with positive remaining space
    non_zero_remaining = remaining_space > 0
    valid_and_nonzero = valid_bins & non_zero_remaining
    priorities[valid_and_nonzero] = -item / remaining_space[valid_and_nonzero]
    return priorities
